name: Watering the Field Trains Building
description: "Watering the field" now gives Building skill, but only when it makes progress towards the garden puzzle (after the lagoon puzzle is complete). Each watering that advances the garden ends with one ordinary Building practice roll, exactly like every other Building job; once the garden is restored, watering gives nothing extra. "Watering crops" and "Trying to water strange patch" are unchanged. **Runs on the Origins-exclusive base, which the patcher installs automatically with it**, so selecting this patch also adds the Origins Upgrades buttons to the Tech and Villager Details screens. That base's companion loads this patch's DLL; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the stock game runs unchanged.
behavior_changes: When a villager's "Watering the field" job reaches its garden progress step (0x43B1E6) while the garden is not yet restored, one practice-Building action (type 6, skill 4) is appended to the end of that villager's job -- the same action every stock Building job queues last, with the stock chance, amount and failure handling. The last watering that completes the garden counts.
explicit_non_changes: This row changes no executable bytes: the Origins companion loads the DLL, which detours 0x43B1E6 at run time only after verifying its twelve stock bytes; a different build of the game installs nothing.
The garden progress itself, its 200-step goal, the lagoon and well requirements, "Watering crops" (Farming) and "Trying to water strange patch" are unchanged.
Once the garden is restored, watering the field queues no extra practice action.
